image_description: A close-up, ground-level shot of a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) standing on soil mixed with small twigs and seeds. The bird is in profile facing left. It displays the characteristic orange-rufous breast and belly, a greyish-black speckled head and throat (indicating non-breeding or female plumage), and black wings with distinct white and yellow wing bars. A second, out-of-focus bird is visible in the upper left background. The lighting is natural and diffuse.
